description: This file defines the ProposedOrder class used in manufacturing resource planning (MRP) within the OFBiz framework. It models proposed orders, including methods for calculating start dates, quantities, and creating requirement records.

classes.name: ProposedOrder
classes.description: Represents a proposed manufacturing order, with properties and methods to calculate start dates, quantities, and to create requirement records within the manufacturing process.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the proposed order.

methods.name: getRequirementStartDate
methods.description: Returns the calculated start date for the requirement.

methods.name: calculateStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the start date for the proposed order based on routing, product type, and other parameters.

methods.name: calculateQuantityToSupply
methods.description: Adjusts the order quantity based on reorder quantity and other factors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a requirement record in the system for this proposed order.

methods.name: setMrpName
methods.description: Sets the MRP name associated with this order.
